cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence:
The code injects HTML tags (
) into content that will be processed by markdown renderers, but CWE-94 specifically requires code execution or syntax modification, not just HTML injection

connection.evidence:
td.lines contains parsed ENEX/HTML table cell content from imported notes, processed through processMdArrayNewLines and then injected with
tags, eventually reaching markdown renderers

diff_causality.evidence:
The patch changes from removing newlines to replacing them with
tags, directly introducing HTML injection capability where none existed before

security_control.evidence:
No HTML escaping or sanitization is applied before injecting
tags; processMdArrayNewLines only handles whitespace normalization
security_control.required_control: HTML escaping or sanitization before injecting HTML tags into markdown content
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-94 requires neutralization of special elements that could modify syntax; HTML tags in markdown can alter rendering behavior
existing_controls_checked: processMdArrayNewLines function only normalizes whitespace, no HTML escaping found
security_control.deficiency_evidence:
The code actively injects
HTML tags without escaping existing HTML content, potentially allowing injection of other HTML elements

concrete_impact.evidence: Impact depends on downstream markdown renderer behavior and whether attacker-controlled HTML can reach this point; only HTML injection to markdown rendering is demonstrated

diff_counterfactual:
If the candidate line were reverted, newlines would be removed entirely instead of being replaced with
tags, preventing HTML injection but potentially breaking formatting.
supporting_evidence:
Code injects raw HTML
tags into table cell content without escaping
td.lines contains parsed ENEX/HTML content from imported notes
No HTML sanitization applied before or after the HTML tag injection
contradicting_evidence: CWE-94 requires code execution or syntax modification, but this demonstrates HTML injection to markdown rendering which is typically a content-level issue
unresolved_facts: Whether markdown renderers used downstream properly escape HTML content
Whether td.lines content can contain user-controlled HTML from imported notes
Whether there are other validation layers before content reaches markdown rendering
review_comment:
The change introduces HTML tag injection by replacing newlines with
tags without proper escaping. While this improves formatting, it creates a potential HTML injection vector if imported ENEX content contains malicious HTML. Apply HTML escaping to the entire cellText content before injecting the
tags to prevent injection of other HTML elements.
